newsitem.title: CANADA: American Sensors stock jumps on earnings.
newsitem.headline: American Sensors stock jumps on earnings.

text.p: Shares in American Sensors Inc rebounded on Wednesday after the company reported improved first-quarter earnings Tuesday and set plans for new markets in Europe.
The stock rose as much as 0.55 to 4.55 in Toronto before settling at 4.35 in light afternoon trading. On Nasdaq, the stock rose 0.25 to 3.25.
The gain reflected the market's renewed confidence in the company, said Stewart Somers, American Sensors chief financial officer.
Last year, the company's stock peaked at 25.25 before starting a gradual descent that took it below 4 last summer.
The company's net earnings for the first quarter ended September 30 rose to C$1.8 million or C$0.18 a share from year earlier $469,000 or C$0.05 a share.
American Sensors, a Canadian manufacturer of indoor air products, also said it received the go-ahead to sell a product that detects hazardous gases to residential customers in the United Kingdom.
